about: Requirements are named <framework key>@<version>#<ref>. A set says its members ask for the same thing; the loader expands it into one crosswalk per pair, and a pair is only as strong as its weaker member (members listed under partial make every pair they are in partial). Be conservative: use related when in doubt. Pairs between two editions of one framework (iso-9001@2015 to iso-9001@2026) are the edition mapping: equivalent means the same requirement, one to one, and only those carry the answers over when a library moves to the new edition.
